Because of that, I’m happily rating it 5/5.
If you’re reading this while deciding whether to book or not — don’t overthink it. It’s a good place with good people running it.

negative_snippets: We had booked a Superior room for 2 nights through EaseMyTrip and made full advanced payment. But when we arrived at the hotel, they told us that the room is not available. They moved us to another room 4-5 km away. Created a lot of inconvenience for us. You are warned.

They changed the location to 7 km away, when I reached their hotel. I had booked this hotel because of its location. Talking to them it came to my understanding that they are running a scam and have been doing to a lot of people. They weren't even apologetic. It's like they know you will not be able to go anywhere else at 1:00 am in the night. I had already paid online through easemytrip. Easetrip hasn't taken any action either against them till now. I had to book my own taxi. The bathroom was so filthy that I didn't even take a bath. And just the water from my bisleri to brush my teeth and got the hell out of there to search for another hotel in the morning. I had read some reviews on google like mine before booking the hotel. But I thought they were rare cases and mistakes happen. But it is apparent they are doing it deliberately. I am writing this review to warn people they are intentionally running a scam.
